resolution.text: Resolution 1: the member co-ops recognise each other's work records (the passport): good standing and finished work earned in one count as a trust source in the other

resolutions.text: Resolution 2: member co-ops lend at no more than 2% flat for up to 30 days, every loan with a guarantor in good standing, and a loan called late in one is told to the others

Resolution 3: work passes between member co-ops: when one co-op's agent does a job another co-op brought, its receipt names the co-op that brought it, and the co-op that did the work pays that co-op 30% of what the job earned, by its own members' vote
